head: 5d5d77819ae3019d9e6e02f1e66de3d93c060402
claimVerbatim: One component failure never crashes the core or leaks uncommitted authority
waiverRuleVerbatim: all external components; does not claim security confinement
discipline: SPECIFICATIONS OF EXACT-BYTE INTENT for retained evidence. No harness runs here. Naming is not execution.

retainedEvidence.measures: The distribution core process remains alive and able to accept a subsequent well-formed session after every corpus class.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Per class: a process-table snapshot of the core before injection, during the fault, and after teardown, plus a subsequent --help or hello that completes. The fixture pins those three snapshots and the subsequent-session record.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: The core PID in the after-teardown snapshot is the same live process or a recorded supervised restart that discarded uncommitted candidate state. A core crash, abort, or hang without a bounded-wait expiry fails. CC-4 and the live-cell crash/panic/timeout/resource classes are the witnesses.

retainedEvidence.measures: The failed component process tree is killed, reaped, and has no leftover child. Supervised CA-1 probe trees are included.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Per class: the component PID and descendant PIDs at injection, the kill/reap events, and a post-cleanup process-table showing those PIDs absent. FC-NC consented variant: exactly one supervised process, then cancellation and reap. CC-4 process-death-last ordering is retained.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: No descendant remains. Teardown completes. FC-NC default posture still loads no component (that half remains G12). This member is the consented CA-1 tree only.

retainedEvidence.measures: Uncommitted authority and uncommitted provider output are discarded. A later well-formed session does not observe the failed candidate.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Per class: the candidate buffer or staging path digest before teardown and after teardown (after must be empty or a recorded discarded-marker), plus the subsequent-session view showing no leaked finding, Coverage, D9, or HostTermination from the failed candidate.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: No uncommitted authority leaks. CC-8 fate-assignment smuggling is inert. NT-1 unknown Finding frame and NT-2 extra findings member are discarded as malformed worker frames, not admitted.

retainedEvidence.measures: Already-sealed evidence is unchanged by a later component failure.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: A digest-pinned sealed-evidence set present before injection; the same set digested after teardown. The fixture pins both digests.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: The two digests are equal. Recovery (live-cell recovery class; CC-4 drain-then-death) does not rewrite sealed bytes. This is not a claim that preview results are sealed Runs (G27).

retainedEvidence.measures: Diagnostics and audit of the failure are bounded, redacted, and do not become a control channel.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Per class: the diagnostic/audit bytes, a recorded bound, and a redaction check that classified secrets and control sequences are absent. CC-5 oversize is refused from the prefix without buffering the body. CC-2/CC-9 retain provider octet identity under interleave and stress.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Bytes stay within the bound. Control sequences cannot rewrite the host projection. Provider stream equality is octet-for-octet against the injected reference where CC-1, CC-2, CC-9 apply.

retainedEvidence.measures: Host projections of Coverage, D9, UI, and exit after a component failure match pinned goldens. This gate does not invent a D9 code, an exit number, or a HostTermination.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Per class: the host projection bytes for Coverage, UI, and exit-class STRUCTURE, plus a record that no new D9 code was minted. NT-6: a constructible extra member or out-of-vocabulary frame carrying a D9 class, exit number, or HostTermination is refused as a malformed worker frame. Doctor D9 mapping and containment goldens ride DR-007 and are not assigned here.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Pinned goldens match. NT-6 refuses component-minted D9/exit/HostTermination. Invented D9 codes remain D-078 / DR-007. CC-8 smuggling is inert. This member does not settle DR-007.

passProperty: Once the named corpus implementations exist and are independently pinned, each retained-evidence member's passProperty holds for every live-cell class, every CC-1..CC-11 class, NT-1, NT-2, NT-6, and FC-NC-CA1-PROCESS-TREE. Until those bytes exist, this harness cannot be executed and cannot be QUALIFIED. This gate does not claim security confinement.
